newsitem.title: UK: IPE gas oil closes up on the day, Brent lower.
newsitem.headline: IPE gas oil closes up on the day, Brent lower.

text.p: IPE gas oil ended on a firmer note on Monday with some good market-on-close buying bringing the October contract back to around middle of the day's range, brokers said.
October gas oil closed up $4 a tonne at $232.50 a tonne, supported by NYMEX heating oil and good fundamental demand.
November Brent crude, trading around $23.10 a barrel at the gas oil close, gained ground to trade at 1705 GMT at $23.30, down 17 cents.
NYMEX gasoline took a nosedive as traders rolled over positions ahead of the spot month expiry Monday, last trading down 1.25 cents at 63.35 cents a gallon.
